kind: Exact-head independent review of public packed audit batch forwarding
head: 18f329ec8ef69a4fd388d5dba47467c5db7aa086
checks: main appends batch=32 without reordering existing parameters and forwards the selected batch to runAudit.remote.
runAudit rejects nonpositive batch before build, records it, forwards it to client.buildFor, and includes the same BATCH in the arithmetic Make invocation.
The existing buildFor includes batch in its baked-binary identity and real make-B command. test-packed-cuda recompiles its executable through the shared DEFS with BATCH.

Every benchmark and DP34 collection sample calls checkScalarCounts with the requested batch and workers. One exact runtime backend row must bindactualBatch,workers,walks,steps andDP weight before count acceptance.
B8/770048,B16/385024,B32/192512 preserve6,160,384 walks and201,863,462,912 scalar updates; completed B32 output cannot satisfy a B8/B16 request merely because its total count matches.
The default32 helper API and omitted batch call signatures retain existing behavior; new requestedBatch/actualBatch result fields are additive.

Tests exercise extracted actual helper/runAudit functions without importing Modal. The nondefault forwarding fixture fails its mocked build when the requested batch differs and inspects the actual arithmetic command.
Count tests cover both benchmark/DP34, explicit andautomaticworkers, wrong geometry with identical total work, missing/duplicate/wrong markers, partial/inflated work, drops andnonfinite rates.
limits: This review ran only the two relevant host-only test scripts. It did not compile CUDA, execute a client, poll a live job, or launch a GPU.
Source forwarding and parser validation do not themselves establish arithmetic correctness or throughput for a new batch; the separately frozen GPU panel provides that evidence.
The public native audit records collection counts/sizes; this change does not add independent corpus-multiset hashing or a cross-batch checkpoint import format.
Only the named three-file batch-forwarding change and necessary existing call paths were reviewed.
